_meta.name: SP4 Self-Preservation Four — Counter-Type Clean Confirmation (v2)
_meta.description: Self-Preservation Four, Tenacity counter-type. Stage 1 raw slider profile leads Type 4 with Type 3 (the SP-4 lookalike) as closest alternate; SP instinct dominant by a wide margin. Stage 2 evidence is Withdrawn / Intensity / Feelings-first. Stage 3 ran in COUNTER-TYPE mode (SP-4 vs Type 3) and the client leaned cleanly to the counter-type (Person A). Stage 4 Option A confirmed cleanly. AI Call #1 flags the SP-4 counter-type (ct_pair) and leads Type 4 (frozen in call1Result); Call #2 returns confirmed_type 4, HIGH confidence, counter_type flag. Call #2 is the unit under test (Call #2 isolation).

stage0Answers.q1: I feel things very deeply, I'm drawn to authenticity and beauty, and I struggle with feeling misunderstood or like something essential is missing in me
stage0Answers.q2: creative, intense, self-absorbed at times, but very genuine and committed
stage0Answers.q3: emotional depth and the ability to connect authentically with what is real and meaningful
stage0Answers.q4: envy — a persistent sense that others have something I lack, which can pull me away from what I actually have

stage1TypeOpen: I don't fall apart when things get hard — I just put my head down and push through, even though underneath there's this ache that I'm somehow not enough. I'd rather prove I can endure than let anyone see me struggle.
stage1InstinctOpen: I'm very focused on managing my own resources and not depending on anyone. I keep a tight handle on my routines, my space, and my energy so I don't get caught off guard.
